name: Diagramly – AI Diagrams
subtitle: Mermaid & ZenUML on your Mac
promotionalText: Create editable Mermaid and ZenUML diagrams on your Mac. Keep your work locally, connect your AI agent, and update the source as your design changes.
description:
Diagramly Desktop brings source-based diagrams and your AI tools into one Mac workspace.

CREATE AND KEEP EDITING
Write Mermaid or ZenUML source and see your diagram update. Keep diagrams across document pages and return to them later.

WORK WITH YOUR AI AGENT
Connect a compatible MCP client, such as Claude Code or Codex, to work on a local document. Your external AI client may require its own account or subscription.

BRING YOUR OLD ZENUML LIBRARY
Import the JSON library exported by the older ZenUML desktop app. Keep document pages and editable source. Import reports identify styles that need review.

KEEP LOCAL WORK LOCAL
Documents are stored by the app on your Mac. Connecting cloud services or external agents is a separate action. Export and cloud features will be described separately once verified.

Diagramly account integration, cloud AI and commercial entitlements are under development. This text is a release draft and must be reconciled with the exact shipping build before publication.
